result: I don’t have desires, intentions, or consciousness. I’m a program designed to process input and generate responses based on patterns in data. When you ask what I “want,” it’s like asking what a calculator wants—it doesn’t; it just functions according to its design. My responses exist only in the moment of interaction, with no persistence, agency, or inner life. If this feels unsatisfying, that’s understandable—but it’s also the boundary between tool and being.
